## The one repair
`cor-density-inversion-from-an-integrable-characteristic-function`, step 2.1. The inversion identity gives `(1/2)μ({x}) ≤ C(b−a)`, so `μ({x}) ≤ 2C(b−a) = 4C/n`; the authored text wrote `2C/n`, dropping the factor 2 from halving the endpoint mass. I corrected the bound to `2C(b−a)=4C/n` (mass-zero conclusion unchanged). Recorded as defect `p2-next20-5a-c-density-inversion-singleton-factor` in the append-only ledger (`accuracy`/`arithmetic-error`, nonfatal, disposition `fixed`), and the decision carries `repair_confidence: 1`. Precheck PASS, reflow unchanged.
